manual_notes: Aggregate comparison, matched filters, counts, route signatures, representative traces and per-agent deltas have substantial code/test evidence. The exact spec requires local-midnight presets; inspected initial and later pinned UI construct presets with start_of_utc_day/Etc/UTC even though timestamps display user timezone. This acceptance mismatch remains unresolved.
rationale: The implementation is real, but display timezone does not make UTC-selected windows start at user local midnight. Strict acceptance of this exact spec is not established. No abandonment inference is made.

sources.observed_facts: Inspected compare_windows queries, shared target/agent/protocol/reachability filtering, timeline and route-signature aggregation, per-agent comparison and tests for uneven samples/route changes; initial UI uses UTC day boundaries.

Later pinned source has full-day/same-hours/rolling presets, drilldown links, baseline notices and user-timezone display, but window_state_from_params uses UTC now and both today presets call start_of_utc_day, which explicitly creates midnight Etc/UTC.
